title: Curium, in collaboration with nuclear cardiology leaders, announces immediate return of Thallous Chloride TI 201 Injection in the U.S. to support high-stakes cardiac imaging needs
llm_note: Curium has resumed production and supply of the nuclear imaging agent Thallous Chloride TI 201 in the U.S.
